name: Atomix
tagline: Build molecules out of single atoms
blurb: Atomix is a puzzle game where your goal is to assemble molecules from compound atoms by moving them on the playfield.
description:
Atomix is a puzzle game where your goal is to assemble molecules from
compound atoms by moving them on the playfield.
However, atoms don’t just move wherever you want to move them to, they
slide until they hit either a wall or another atom.

Try to build the molecules as fast as you can on each level to earn a
higher score.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
